title: Maqtal se aaraha hai gulgoo qaba ka laasha
body:
MAQTAL SE AA RAHA HAI GULG00 QABA KA LAASHA
QAIMO'N MEIN SHAHE DEE'N KE EK HASHR SA HAI BARPA.
1. JIS DAM SADA E QASIM asws. MAQTAL SE AAYI SHEH KO.
MAIDA'N MEIN DAUDE SARWAR asws. KEHTE HUE YEH DEKHO.
ABBAS asws. AUR AKBAR asws. AB RAN KO JALD POHONCHO.
TAB TAK HASSAN asws. KA DILBAR PAAMAL HO CHUKA THA.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. ALLAH KYA GAZAB KA ASHOOR KA WO DIN THA.
DULHAN BANI THI KUBRA sa. QASIM asws. BANA THA DULHA.
KARNE JIHAAD RAN KO POHONCHA HASSAN asws. KA BETA.
SHIDDAT KI TISHNAGI MEIN KAB TAK SAHEGA HAMLA
<<DIVIDER>>
3. PANI KAHA'N SE LAAYE SHIDDAT KI TISHNAGI MEIN.
SHARBAT BANAYE KAISE SHADI KI IS QUSHI MEIN.
KAISA YEH GHAM HAI AAYA KUBRA sa. KI ZINDAGI MEIN.
LAMHO'N KA EK DULHA APNI DULHAN SE BICHDA.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. SHADI KI JAA PA MATAM SHADI KA HO RAHA HAI.
ODHE HUE WO DULHAN MAILI SI EK RIDA HAI.
QUSHIYO'N KA HAAYE PAL MEIN MANZAR BADAL GAYA HAI.
AANSOO BAHA RAHI HAI SAR KO JHUKAYE KUBRA sa.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. THI MAA KI YEH WASIYAT ZINDA NA RAN SE AANA.
AY MERE LAAL APNA WAADA NA BHOOL JAANA.
BABA KI AB NIYABAT TUMKO HI HAI NIBHANA.
ZINDA TO JAA RAHE HO QAIME MEIN AAYE LAASHA.
<<DIVIDER>>
7. POHONCHE JO SHAH RAN KO MUSHKIL KI WO GHADI THI.
MAIDAN E KARBALA MEIN QUSHBOO GULO'N KI MEHKI.
BIKHRI HUI JO RAN MEIN SEHRE KI HAR KALI THI.
APNI ABAA MEIN LAASHA CHUNTE HAI SHAHE WAALA.
<<DIVIDER>>
8. DEKHI GAYI NA SHADI AISI KOI JAHA'N MEIN.
HAR EK BARATI JISKA MASROOF HAI FUGH'AN MEIN.
CHAAYA SOHAIL AISA GHAM ARZ AUR SAMA MEIN.
AANSOO BAHAKE APNE PADHTE HAI SAB YEH NAUHA.
AZ: JANAB RAZA ALI ""SOHAIL"" SAHAB.
